rules.name: THE TERROR OF A SLOWLY UNFOLDING PLAGUE
rules.text: When [Disease] would prevent a Build on a board with your [Presence] , you may let the Build happen (removing no [Disease] ). If you do, 1 [Fear] .
rules.turn:
#acc has-any-presence : spirit
presence-of S P, at P L, land L / has-any-presence S
build-step, spirit:special S plague, has-any-presence S, has-disease L
  invader-card:build C, card:terrain C T, land:terrain L T, has-invaders L
  ?[rng] Y
  !(yes-no Y)
  ~plague-decides L Y
build-step, (plague-decides L Y), is Y yes, { remove-one L disease => ~plague-build L }
plague-build L, +fear-from (plague L) 1
plague-build L, land:count L town Nt, land:count L city Nc, gt Nt Nc, ~add-piece L city
plague-build L, land:count L town Nt, land:count L city Nc, le Nt Nc, ~add-piece L town
rules.evidence: with ext-disease.t: seeds 7/1/3 choose yes -> plague-build l1 adds a Town/City, Disease stays (count l1 disease 1), +1 Fear; seed 2 declines -> remove-one l1 disease.
rules.notes: An exception on another extension's exception: Disease already consumed the `build L` tuple and re-emitting `build L` inside build-step would be intercepted by Disease again (loop), so 'let the Build happen' restates the two base Build rules for plague-build. Works, but anything that later modifies `build` (e.g. Fathomless Mud) won't see these builds. Decision is taken at build-step start; the exception is then conditioned on the `is` answer.

rules.name: LINGERING PESTILENCE
rules.text: When your [Presence] is destroyed by anything except a Spirit action, add 1 [Disease] where each destroyed [Presence] was.
rules.turn:
destroy-presence C, is C X, presence-of S X, spirit:special S lingering, at X L
  ~lingering S L
lingering S L, ~add-piece L disease
use-power S P, { lingering _ _ => }
rules.evidence: Event-style Blight in l2 destroys g1 -> lingering plague l2, Disease added; plague's own Power adds Blight to l3 destroying g2 -> no Disease (seeds 1/2/3).
rules.notes: 'except a Spirit action' is a nice fit: the trigger is cancelled by an empty exception scoped to every use-power episode. Requires that all Spirit actions run inside a recognisable episode (use-power; growth would need the same).

rules.name: WREAK VENGEANCE FOR THE LAND'S CORRUPTION
rules.text: Your actions treat [Blight] on the island as also being [Badlands] .
rules.turn: spirit:special S wreak, at B L, piece:kind B blight / badlands-for S L 1
rules.evidence: fever's 1 Damage in l2 (1 Blight) -> damage-total plague l2 2.
rules.notes: Works because the BASE-EXT counts Badlands through a per-actor view (badlands-for S L); 'your actions' is the actor key.

base_ext: yes/no decisions; Badlands as a per-actor @sum view used by Power damage; Power effects as rules keyed on power:effect. The played cards are a turn-scoped acc view (`#acc played`, `turn … / played …`): a `turn, ^played …` view now starts concurrently with the phases.
language_issues: An exception cannot be partially undone: once `{ build L => … }` has fired, the original tuple is gone, so an extension of the extension must re-implement the base effect (duplicating base rules).
With core's unbounded cascades, any scenario where Ravage blights adjacent lands exhausts tuple-gas (50000 rows): acc rows multiply per moment. The test Defends the Ravage to stay under the limit.
